title: AG’s office releases videos of Syracuse police encounter with man who later died
summary: The New York State Attorney General's Office released police body camera videos documenting a Syracuse Police Department encounter with a man who subsequently died in 2023. This transparency action relates to ongoing investigation and public accountability regarding the incident. The CIO should monitor for potential records management, evidence handling systems, and public records technology implications.
